description.value:
The auri are split into two clans, the Raen and Xaela. The Xaela tend to be wiser and stronger, but their fierce brute looks are a bit intimidating.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Au Ra (Xaela) gain +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, and –2 Charisma.
  • Type: Auri are Humanoid creatures with the Au ra subtype.
  • Size: Auri are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
  • Base Speed: Auri have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Auri begin play speaking Common and Draconic. Auri with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Elvaan, Galkan, Goblin, Kojin, Matanga, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Elemental Resistance: Auri have ice resistance 5, lightning resistance 5, and fire resistance 5.
  • Scales: Auri's patches of scales grant them a +1 natural armor bonus to their Armor Class.
  • Fearless: Auri get a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Imposing Figure: Xaela gain a +2 racial bonus to Intimidate checks.
  • Survivalist: All auri gain a +2 racial bonus on all Survival checks.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: Auri can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.
